title: Battle of Topáter
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Topáter", at revision 1370275640, opens: "The Battle of Topáter, or Battle of Calama, was fought on March 23, 1879, between Chile and Bolivia. It was the first battle of the War of the Pacific." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3320910, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1879 battle of the War of the Pacific". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
